name: chatpanel-sdk
description: ChatPanel client SDKs — one OpenAPI contract for the local gateway, generated into every language.

scripts.generate: npm run lint && npm run gen:core && npm run gen:all
scripts.test: node tools/lint-spec.mjs && node tools/gen-core.mjs --check && npm --prefix sdk/typescript test && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test:py
